outgoing.name: Alexander the Great
outgoing.excerpt: After Mausolus and Artemisia, he had several other sons and daughters: Ada (adopted mother of Alexander), Idrieus and Pixodarus.

outgoing.name: Architecture
outgoing.excerpt: The structure was designed by the Greek architects Satyrus and Pythius.

outgoing.name: Democracy
outgoing.excerpt: He founded many cities of Greek design along the coast and encouraged Greek democratic traditions.

outgoing.name: Money
outgoing.excerpt: Mausolus and Artemisia spent huge amounts of tax money to embellish the city.

outgoing.name: Pyramid
outgoing.excerpt: The roof, which comprised most of the final third of the height, was in the form of a pyramid.

outgoing.name: Sand
outgoing.excerpt: His workmen deepened the city's harbour and used the dragged sand for to make protecting arms in front of the channel.

outgoing.name: Theatre
outgoing.excerpt: On land, the workmen built also walls and watchtowers, a Greek– style theatre and a temple to Ares, the Greek god of war.
